question: For $$A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}-5 & 2 \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix},$$ calculate $A+B$ and $B+A$. Hence verify the commutative property of matrix addition.
explanation:
Addition in the order $A+B$
$$A+B=\begin{bmatrix}2+(-5) & -1+2 \\ 3+1 & 4+0\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 1 \\ 4 & 4\end{bmatrix}$$
Addition in the order $B+A$
$$B+A=\begin{bmatrix}-5+2 & 2+(-1) \\ 1+3 & 0+4\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 1 \\ 4 & 4\end{bmatrix}$$
Commutative property
Since $A+B=B+A$, the commutative property of matrix addition is verified.
